# Anchorline Orders — Service Health

A one-page workbook for the Orders API showing request rate, error rate, and p95 latency by revision. Time range is parameterized.

content.query: requests | where cloud_RoleName == '{ApiName}' | summarize rps=count()/60.0 by bin(timestamp, 1m) | render timechart
content.title: Requests per second

content.query: requests | where cloud_RoleName == '{ApiName}' | summarize total=count(), errors=countif(success==false) by bin(timestamp, 1m) | extend errorPct = 100.0 * errors / total | project timestamp, errorPct | render timechart
content.title: Error rate (%)

content.query: requests | where cloud_RoleName == '{ApiName}' | summarize p95=percentile(duration, 95) by bin(timestamp, 1m) | render timechart
content.title: p95 latency (ms)

content.query: requests | where cloud_RoleName == '{ApiName}' | summarize count() by cloud_RoleInstance | render barchart
content.title: Request count by revision (instance)
